{"id":1903872745,"question_id":4118,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"5 months, 3 weeks","timestamp":1769917274,"status":10,"status_display":"Accepted","runtime":"87 ms","url":"/submissions/detail/1903872745/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Design Ride Sharing System","memory":"183.3 MB","code":"class RideSharingSystem {\npublic:    \n    queue<int>rider;\n    queue<int>driver;\n    RideSharingSystem() {\n        \n    }\n    \n    void addRider(int riderId) {\n        rider.push(riderId);\n    }\n    \n    void addDriver(int driverId) {\n        driver.push(driverId);\n    }\n    \n    vector<int> matchDriverWithRider() {\n        vector<int>temp;\n        if(!rider.empty() and !driver.empty()){\n            temp = {driver.front() , rider.front()};\n            rider.pop();\n            driver.pop();\n        }\n        else temp = {-1 , -1};\n        return temp;\n    }\n    \n    void cancelRider(int riderId) {\n        queue<int>remains;\n        while(!rider.empty()){\n            int front = rider.front();\n            rider.pop();\n            if(riderId != front) remains.push(front);\n        }\n        rider = remains;\n    }\n};\n\n/**\n * Your RideSharingSystem object will be instantiated and called as such:\n * RideSharingSystem* obj = new RideSharingSystem();\n * obj->addRider(riderId);\n * obj->addDriver(driverId);\n * vector<int> param_3 = obj->matchDriverWithRider();\n * obj->cancelRider(riderId);\n */","compare_result":"","title_slug":"design-ride-sharing-system","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1625}
